summary: QV.23.100 analysis notebook for Corvenlith Therapeutics. It sets out the donor-balanced design for the immune-cell RNA-seq, the differential expression contrasts with log2 fold change and adjusted probability thresholds, and the donor-balanced receptor-pathway ranking that moved target prioritisation away from the apparent inflammatory signature. The v3 readout carries the interpretation; the earlier contrasts are kept here as qualified context.
